title: Agent topology graph
decision: Create a separate future Feature for a global Agents topology graph; ship only the navigation naming and hierarchy correction now.
constraints: Agents hides the Project Rail while active.
Active Agents are central; inactive Agents remain visible but muted.
Same Project or Demand creates proximity; Project groups receive polygon boundaries.
Use existing Session/Agent/Project/Demand facts and status vocabulary.
Design an accessible non-graph fallback and reduced-motion behavior before implementation.
